method.method_draft: 从题干文字将前两个不等式化为边界直线 y=x+3 与 y=-x-1，并知道第三条边界是 x=k。再从图像中读取右侧竖直边界与斜边的交点坐标信息，例如下端点位于直线 y=-x-1 上且纵坐标读为 -2，或上端点位于 y=x+3 上且纵坐标读为 4。若用下端点，代入 y=-2 到 x+y+1=0，得 x=1；若用上端点，代入 y=4 到 y=x+3，也得 x=1。该交点同时在 x=k 上，所以 k=1。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中前两个不等式对应的边界直线为 y=x+3 与 y=-x-1，第三条边界是右侧竖直直线 x=k。图像上可读出这条竖直边界与下斜边 y=-x-1 的交点纵坐标为 -2；也可读出它与上斜边 y=x+3 的交点纵坐标为 4。
再推理：由 x-y+3=0 得边界 y=x+3；由 x+y+1=0 得边界 y=-x-1。若取下端点，它在 y=-x-1 上且 y=-2，代入 x+y+1=0，得 x-2+1=0，所以 x=1。该点又在竖直边界 x=k 上，因此 k=1。用上端点验证：y=4 代入 y=x+3，得 4=x+3，所以 x=1，同样得到 k=1。

method.CoT_final:
First describe the graph: in the figure, the boundary straight lines corresponding to the first two inequalities are y=x+3 and y=-x-1, and the third boundary is the vertical straight line x=k on the right side. From the graph it can be read that the y-coordinate of the intersection point of this vertical boundary and the lower oblique side y=-x-1 is -2; it can also be read that the y-coordinate of its intersection point with the upper oblique side y=x+3 is 4.
Then reason: From x-y+3=0, obtain the boundary y=x+3; from x+y+1=0, obtain the boundary y=-x-1. If taking the lower endpoint, it is on y=-x-1 and y=-2. Substituting into x+y+1=0 gives x-2+1=0, so x=1. This point is also on the vertical boundary x=k, therefore k=1. Use the upper endpoint to verify: substituting y=4 into y=x+3 gives 4=x+3, so x=1, likewise obtaining k=1.
